name: Italy

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 58943464 inhabitants, recorded as 58.943 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.
Opening estimate, produced with no source and no research. It exists to be falsified, not to be used as data.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The Italian trainings identified in teatro di figura all belong to private or association bodies outside the denominator: the two-year academy of the Centro Teatro Internazionale in Florence, the Libera Accademia del Teatro dell'Aria attached to the Perugia festival, the Animateria pathway, the Universita dei Burattini in Cesenatico. The only foothold in public education is the Teatro di figura subject taught within the scenography course of the Academy of Fine Arts in Catania: a subject in a curriculum, not a specialised training, and so it does not satisfy the denominator. No specialised degree was found. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1, the check not having covered the curricula of every academy of fine arts and national drama school. Italy is the case the schema explicitly flags as understated by an institutional indicator. Re-examined on 2026-07-27 after the ownership ruling. Italy is the country the ruling threatened to change most, since the whole of its recorded provision was set aside as private, and private was the word doing the work. Both establishments on record were therefore re-read at source, on the award this time. The Centro Teatro Internazionale in Florence presents itself as an Accademia di formazione teatrale over two years and names no titolo, no diploma and no accreditation: nothing MUR or AFAM, nothing regional. It is excluded on the absence of a state-recognised award, and its reason moves from private to not_degree_granting. The Libera Accademia del Teatro dell'Aria in Perugia could not be settled: its site shows laboratori and formazione teatrale but the pages that would state what, if anything, is awarded were not reachable, so it moves from private to unconfirmed and now carries the source that was actually read. The two remaining trainings named in this reasoning, Animateria and the Universita dei Burattini in Cesenatico, were never opened in either pass and were set aside under the same withdrawn motive; they are not recorded as establishments and stay unexamined. The value holds at 0, but the upper bound of 1 is now doing more work than before: it carries three unopened files, not one gap in coverage.

establishments.name: Centro Teatro Internazionale — Scuola per attori marionettisti
establishments.award: Two-year Accademia di formazione teatrale; no titolo, diploma or MUR/AFAM accreditation named at source
establishments.description: A private academy training puppeteer-actors and puppet builders across string, rod, hand and body puppet techniques, over two years. Excluded because its site names no state-recognised title: since the ruling of 2026-07-27 being private is no ground, awarding nothing the State recognises is.

establishments.name: Libera Accademia del Teatro dell'Aria (Tieffeu)
establishments.award: Not established: the site shows laboratori and formazione teatrale, the pages stating what is awarded were unreachable
establishments.description: A private academy attached to the international festival of animated figures, teaching head carving, marionette animation and vocal technique. Its place in the count is unresolved rather than decided: the ruling of 2026-07-27 made the award the test, and what it awards could not be read.

observations.reasoning: DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
